note: Bill's stock lines. Jev picks a slot (by `use`); the app plays that slot's `lines` in a loop: a shuffled order kept on the phone, never the same line twice in a row, reshuffled at the end of each pass. Every line is rendered once per (voice, model) and played from local storage. No task names or user content: anything specific is said by the writer after the stock line. Tone: warm, dry, brief.

groups.ack: Short acknowledgement before or instead of an answer
groups.start: A new agent task was started
groups.update: A message was passed to a running task
groups.status: Progress on running tasks, when nothing more specific is needed
groups.result: Lead-in before reading a finished task's result
groups.clarify: Didn't catch it, or need more
groups.listen: Backchannel while the user is mid-thought (off by default)
groups.wait: Filler while waiting on the network or the writer
groups.approval: A task needs a tap on screen
